One record.
Clear responsibilities.

Bordeon connects post-bind insurance operations with customer and finance systems. Explore the intended system boundaries and product model below.

The working demo supports manual intake, policy versions, premium adjustments, two-carrier allocation, CSV reports and demo settlement status. Other capabilities below describe the product direction.

01 / BIND INTAKE

Create accepted business manually or import CSV/XLSX. Use assisted PDF extraction where it helps.

From accepted business to carrier obligations: each step reuses the same record and preserves its history.

CARRIER-READY OUTPUTS

The bordereau becomes an output — not your database.

Generate risk and premium bordereaux from the same record. Map each carrier’s required columns to reusable templates instead of maintaining separate spreadsheet logic.
